title: Drying-induced stress and deformation for clays: a numerical study of the problem
locators: PDF pp. 3–5, 8–10 (0-based indices in web extraction); abstract, introduction, mechanical model
facts: Kaolin brick drying is modeled using moisture diffusion, shrinkage-dependent strains and elastic stress.
The abstract reports a cracking criterion maximum at the surface near a symmetry axis around 40 minutes, with an elevated initial risk period.
The mechanical model is explicitly a perfectly elastic approximation; moisture-dependent properties and missing viscoelastic data limit it.
supports: Early moisture/shrinkage gradients can matter before a body's single lumped leather-hard threshold.
doesNotVerify: No wind-pulse/recovery trial on coiled pots; no calibrated stress relaxation time or crack probability for island clay.
